Fully label-driven (by node/namespace/storageclass/bucket) so it adapts as nodes, PVCs and buckets come and go. Metrics from Mimir (uid: mimir).

options.content:
**These require new scrape targets/exporters (not built here to avoid broken panels):**

- **PVC *used* bytes** — `kubelet_volume_stats_*` is not scraped. This dashboard shows PVC *requested* size only. Fix: add a kubelet metrics scrape (`/metrics` volume stats) to Alloy so `kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes` / `_capacity_bytes` appear.
- **etcd DB size** — `etcd_mvcc_db_total_size_in_bytes` is not scraped (Talos control-plane etcd metrics endpoint not wired). Fix: expose + scrape etcd metrics, then add a panel with a quota threshold.

**Gaps filled in this change:** MinIO object/bucket usage (native PodMonitor + public metrics), and NAS/NFS free space (`nfs-storage-exporter` df probe). CloudNativePG per-database sizes already existed (`cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes`).

panels.description: SCOPE: kubelet_volume_stats_* is only emitted for PVCs whose volume plugin has a stats provider — on this cluster that means NFS-backed PVCs ONLY (fatboy-nfs-appdata, synology-nfs, tdarr-*). The ~52 local-path/hostPath PVCs will NEVER appear here (by design, not a bug). Do not read these panels as all-PVC coverage.

options.content:
**Scope — NFS-backed PVCs only.** `kubelet_volume_stats_*` is only emitted for PVCs whose volume plugin has a stats provider — on this cluster that is the **NFS-backed PVCs only** (fatboy-nfs-appdata, synology-nfs, tdarr-*). The ~52 local-path/hostPath PVCs will **never** appear here (by design, not a bug) — do **not** read these panels as all-PVC coverage.

Notes: most NFS PVCs share the same NAS backend, so used% is the backend filesystem fill and moves in lockstep. RWX PVCs mounted on multiple nodes are deduplicated with `max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim)`. Inode panels are omitted: `kubelet_volume_stats_inodes*` exists but NFS reports 0 inodes, so inode-% is undefined here.

panels.title: Scope: NFS-backed PVCs only (kubelet volume-stats)

panels.description: Count of NFS-backed PVCs whose filesystem is more than 85% full. NFS-backed PVCs only — local-path PVCs never emit kubelet_volume_stats_* (see scope note).

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes) > 85) or vector(0)

panels.title: NFS PVCs >85% full

panels.description: NFS-backed PVCs whose available bytes, linearly extrapolated from the last 24h (predict_linear), go negative within 7 days. 0 = nothing on track to fill. NFS-backed PVCs only (see scope note).
panels.title: Projected full <7d

panels.description: Live filesystem fill per NFS-backed PVC from kubelet volume stats: capacity, used, available and used-%. Deduplicated across nodes (RWX PVCs mount on several nodes) with max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim). NFS-backed PVCs only — local-path PVCs never appear here (see scope note). Most rows share the same NAS backend so used-% is near-identical by design.
panels.title: NFS PVC fill — capacity / used / available / used-%

panels.description: Available bytes per NFS-backed PVC over time — the fill trend. Deduplicated with max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim). Because most PVCs share the same NAS backend the lines largely overlap; divergent lines are dedicated exports. NFS-backed PVCs only (see scope note).
panels.title: Available bytes per PVC (trend)

panels.description: Naive linear forecast: available_bytes / deriv(used_bytes[6h]) in days, only for PVCs actively filling (deriv > 0). clamp_min guards divide-by-zero. May be sparse or empty when nothing is filling — that is fine. Since most PVCs share one NAS backend, their days-to-full converge on the backend's number. NFS-backed PVCs only (see scope note).

targets.expr: (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim=~"$pvc"}) / max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (clamp_min(deriv(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim=~"$pvc"}[6h]), 1)) / 86400) and max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (deriv(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{persistentvolumeclaim=~"$pvc"}[6h])) > 0

panels.title: Fill forecast — days to full (actively filling PVCs)
